stem.text: Which statement about the movement of water from roots to leaves is **not** correct?

A.text: A continuous column of water is partly maintained by the attraction of water molecules to cellulose.

B.text: Hydrogen bonding between water molecules enables mass flow of water.

C.text: Hydrostatic pressure in xylem vessel elements is higher in roots than in leaves.

D.text: Water potential changes throughout the length of the xylem vessel elements.
